ruleDefinitions.name: PHP Process Spawning Shell or Network Tool
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PHP or PHP-FPM spawning shell interpreters or network utilities, which is a common indicator of PHP-based Remote Code Execution (RCE) or web shell activity.

sequences.name: PHP spawning suspicious child process
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND parent_process_name:WLDi("*php*") AND process_name:("bash", "sh", "dash", "zsh", "ksh", "nc", "ncat", "netcat", "socat", "curl", "wget", "python", "python3", "perl") AND outcome:"success"
